remarks:
Move-in ready!
Welcome to small-town living at its finest in the picturesque village of Angelica, NY! With its storybook charm and Hallmark movie atmosphere, Angelica is a place where community and tradition come together. Stroll through the village's quaint Main Street antique shops, enjoy the weekly farmers market at the beautiful park circle, or take in the many festivals, live music events, and community gatherings that make this village so special.

Just as charming as its surroundings, this lovingly remodeled 3-bedroom, 2-full-bath home offers the perfect blend of character, comfort, and modern updates. The extensive list of improvements includes an entirely new electrical system, all-new plumbing, new metal roof, a new furnace and hot water tank, new flooring and ceilings, updated light fixtures, beautiful butcher block countertops, and fresh paint both inside and out. It's move-in ready!

The thoughtfully designed layout features a convenient first-floor primary suite and first-floor laundry, making everyday living a breeze. Outside, you'll find inviting spaces to relax and entertain, whether you're sipping your morning coffee on the front porch, unwinding on the side porch, enjoying dinner on the new back deck, or gathering with friends around the backyard fire pit. A concrete pad in the driveway is already in place, offering a head start for a future garage.

Beautifully updated, full of charm, and nestled in one of Western New York's most delightful small towns, this home offers more than just a place to live—it's a lifestyle you'll love coming home to!
